depends_on.name: software_id
depends_on.documentation: Which program this method runs in, or configures.

depends_on.name: entity_id
depends_on.documentation: OPTIONAL scope: settings that apply to ONE entity. (`subject_id` until 2026-10-08.)

depends_on.name: epoch_id
depends_on.documentation: OPTIONAL scope: settings that apply to ONE epoch.

depends_on.name: parent_id
depends_on.documentation: The named protocol this one is a variant of. LINEAGE ONLY -- it records origin, not precedence, and the variant carries a COMPLETE copy of every setting rather than a diff. Named for its role (T15: `parent_id`, the generic lineage edge).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The protocol's name, e.g. "default". OPTIONAL: a scoped variant need not be named. Decided by #73 item 54: this field, not `base.name` (did_v1 only), holds the name. NDI's readers that query `base.name` (spikeextractor.m:372, spikesorter.m:373) must read this field for V_eta documents -- a PR #76 checklist item.

fields.name: term
fields.documentation: The technique or stimulus kind, as a term (a spike-sorting algorithm, "drifting sinusoidal grating"). Blank when the source names only the settings. The same field as an interaction's inline `method.term`.

fields.name: node
fields.documentation: The CURIE (prefix resolved via CURIE_lookups_meta.json).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The human-readable label.

fields.name: parameters
fields.documentation: The settings themselves -- the same list as an interaction's inline `method.parameters`. A stimulus given as a recipe carries its settings here (orientation, spatial frequency, temporal frequency, contrast ...). `method_parameters` until 2026-10-21. Each entry is {variable, unit, source_unit, approximate} plus exactly ONE value form -- `term`, `quantity` {value, source_value}, `count`, `text`, `logical` or `matrix` (a numeric N-D array, data_body AMENDMENT 4) -- the same entry as a covariate's, holding one value where a covariate holds one per position along its dimensions (2026-10-19; data_body plan AMENDMENT 6). NEW NUMERIC SHAPE (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md [one shape for measured numbers], Jess Haley, 2026-11-17, sections 4 and 6): the entry is flat -- a number is `numeric` (canonical, in `unit`; an array at each position adds dimensions; a single number is written as a plain number, [numeric shape details] (3)) with `unit`, `source_numeric`, `source_unit` and `tolerance` only beside it; `count`, `term`, `text`, `logical` are unchanged and carry no unit. `quantity` and `matrix` are the OLD SHAPE, read until the readers drop it (section 9, step 4). `source_numeric` holds what the source held, in the source's own type: a number where v1 stored a number, text where v1 stored text ([numeric shape details] (1)). A schema field holds one type, so it is not declared here yet: DID-matlab did2.schema.numericShapeFields declares it (text, or a number) until the old shape is removed.

fields.name: variable
fields.documentation: WHAT knob this is. Bound {strength: preferred, node_form: curie}, and UNIQUE within the list. Identity lives in a bound variable, so domain-specific knobs are DATA rather than schema and no class or field is minted per program. A knob with no ontology term is a LABEL ({name}, no node; item 33), so every setting fits this list and nothing needs an untyped bag. The entry has the same shape as a condition entry, and as a covariate's without `along`.

fields.name: node
fields.documentation: The CURIE (prefix resolved via CURIE_lookups_meta.json).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The human-readable label.

fields.name: unit
fields.documentation: Canonical unit of `quantity.value`, for the whole setting. Absent for a non-numeric value or a unitless number. A registered unit term (schemas/registry/did_v2_term_registry.json), the canonical unit of the variable's quantity: the list is tools/canonical_units.py, read by tools/check_term_registry.py (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [units bound]). In the new numeric shape: the canonical unit of `numeric` only; absent beside `count`, `term`, `text`, `logical` (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md [one shape for measured numbers], Jess Haley, 2026-11-17, section 6).

fields.name: node
fields.documentation: The CURIE (prefix resolved via CURIE_lookups_meta.json).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The human-readable label.

fields.name: source_unit
fields.documentation: The unit the source gave the value in, as a term: the unit's registered term (schemas/registry/did_v2_term_registry.json), its label as the name (did_v2_source_unit_plan.md). Blank when the source gives no unit. In the new numeric shape: only with `numeric` (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md [one shape for measured numbers], Jess Haley, 2026-11-17, section 6).

fields.name: node
fields.documentation: The CURIE (prefix resolved via CURIE_lookups_meta.json).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The human-readable label.

fields.name: approximate
fields.documentation: Applies to the whole setting.

fields.name: term
fields.documentation: A categorical value: one term ({node, name}), or a LABEL ({name}, no node) when no term exists. Open by design: no binding on this slot, because what it may hold depends on the entry's `variable`; a `subject_statement_bindings` row with `values` closes it per variable (Jess Haley 2026-11-10 [unbound term fields sorted], did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md).

fields.name: node
fields.documentation: The CURIE (prefix resolved via CURIE_lookups_meta.json).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The human-readable label.

fields.name: numeric
fields.documentation: The canonical number(s), in `unit`: one per position along the `along` dimensions on a covariate, one value on a condition or parameter; an array at each position adds dimensions (replaces `quantity.value` and `matrix`). A single number is written as a plain number, an array keeps its dimensions (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md [numeric shape details] (3)). Has a `unit` unless the variable is unitless or the run's report lists a gap. One value form. (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md [one shape for measured numbers], Jess Haley, 2026-11-17, section 4.)

fields.name: source_numeric
fields.documentation: What the source wrote for the number, in the source's own type: a number where v1 stored a number, text where v1 stored text, kept verbatim (v1 writes a threshold as the string "0.030", and the trailing zero is the stated precision). Filled only for a number written by v1. In `source_unit`.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.documentation: The bound on the number(s): the true value lies between `numeric - minus` and `numeric + plus`, in `unit`. One for the whole entry (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md [series readings share a source record]). ABSENT means no tolerance is stated. A bound, not a standard deviation. Only with `numeric` (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md section 6). (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md [one shape for measured numbers], Jess Haley, 2026-11-17.)

fields.name: minus
fields.documentation: How far BELOW the stated number the true value may lie, in `unit`. Non-negative.

fields.name: plus
fields.documentation: How far ABOVE the stated number the true value may lie, in `unit`. Non-negative.

fields.name: quantity
fields.documentation: OLD SHAPE: read until the readers drop it (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md section 9, step 4), then removed by did-schema ([one shape for measured numbers]). The writers write the new shape (DID-matlab #473, NDI-matlab #1258). Replaced by `numeric`. Was: A numeric value, in `unit`, plus what the source wrote.

fields.name: value
fields.documentation: Canonical value, in `unit`.

fields.name: source_value
fields.documentation: As-recorded value, VERBATIM in `source_unit` (v1 writes a threshold as the string "0.030", and the string is kept).

fields.name: count
fields.documentation: An integer value.

fields.name: text
fields.documentation: A free-text value.

fields.name: logical
fields.documentation: A true/false value (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [logical entries]): whether a setting was on, whether a condition held. One value form.

fields.name: matrix
fields.documentation: OLD SHAPE: read until the readers drop it (did_v2_numeric_shape_plan.md section 9, step 4), then removed by did-schema ([one shape for measured numbers]). The writers write the new shape (DID-matlab #473, NDI-matlab #1258). Replaced by `numeric`. Was: A numeric N-D array value, in `unit` (absent for unitless numbers): row-major as JSON nested arrays, every dimension written: an n x 3 palette is [[r, g, b], ...], one inner array per row, and a vector is written with its dimension as one row [[a, b, c]] or one column [[a], [b], [c]], never a flat [a, b, c], which cannot say which (data_body plan AMENDMENT 4, corrected 2026-10-21). The whole array is ONE value of the entry's `variable`; it is not split into entries. (data_body AMENDMENT 4, 2026-10-21.)
